notes.title: Patch 1.250426
notes.content:
[olist]

[/list]

[/list]
[] "White Screen" when right clicking in main menu
[list]
[] Repositioned the alternate view cameras to be outside of Rho (the big orb in the middle)
[/list]
[/list]
[] OPEN/PENDING Issues
[list]
[] Upgrade text bugs
[list]
[] Will fix them as they pop up or I discover them. I decided to do Rich Text on the upgrade descriptions and will probably regret it for years to come.
[/list]
[] HP/5 permgrade not working (maybe)
[list]
[] Investigating.
[/list]
[] Pause Menu "Ignore Player Assigned" malfunctioning
[list]
[] Investigating - The in-game panel does work, pause menu does not. I screwed something up.
[/list]
[] No reverse
[list]
[] Hellbeast reverse thrust was bugged. Investigating for general issues.
[/list]
[] Caligo-Moonwake ship cannot be seen in ship selection
[list]
[] MoonWake is not in the game yet. It probably breaks the game's mind trying to find it in the main menu.
[/list]
[] Invisible walls?
[list]
[] Bad shader and/or material. I'm blaming this one on Unreal. I removed that material and will investigate at some point.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 04/20/2025
notes.content:
Based on feedback from NextFest, I've added some features to the demo as I prepare to go into Early Access:  
  
Direct Targeting -  You can now select and enemy directly. Your weapons will attempt to target that enemy if they are able.  

Enemy Info - Information on a given enemy now displays when you hover your cursor over it.  
  
Objective and Enemy Indicators -  Icons will appear at the edge of your screen to tell you where important objects or enemies are in relation to your viewpoint.  Objectives now have a HUD icon that will follow them for easier identification.
